Name: Throwable Axe
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Throw your axe at monsters to damage them.
Description:
**Throwable Axe** lets you throw your axe at monsters to damage them.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
Select an axe in your toolbar and right-click to throw it! Better axes go faster and do more damage. The axe will return automatically so you can do it again.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/ThrowableAxe/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
